title: Custom Query Hooks
description: Learn how to create reusable custom query hooks.

data.text: Creating **custom query hooks** is a best practice for React Query. It encapsulates query logic and makes it reusable across components.

data.title: Custom Hook
Organization
data.text: Organize custom hooks in a hooks/ directory, with one file per domain (useUsers.ts, usePosts.ts).

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Custom hooks are the best practice for React Query.
